purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.text: NDee offers free wellbeing exercises and a personal reflection questionnaire. It does not provide a diagnosis or medical care. In immediate danger, contact local emergency services.

use.title: Use and availability
use.text: Adapt exercises to your abilities and stop if uncomfortable. Choose your own practices. The service may change or be interrupted. Browser storage may be cleared: keep your exports if you want a copy of your profile.

contributions.title: Contributions and content
contributions.text: Only submit content you are entitled to share, without other people’s personal data or illegal content. Exercises are moderated. Respect authors’ rights and applicable content licences.

external.title: Links and support
external.text: External resources and financial support are optional. Third-party services have their own terms and privacy policies. No payment is required to access exercises or the questionnaire.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.text: NDee is published privately in Belgium by Kash Hauzeur, responsible for publication.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.text: The site is hosted by Contabo. Official hosting-provider contact details are available through the link below.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: For questions about the site, content or your data, contact the publisher:

local.title: Questionnaire and local storage
local.text: Answers, results, progress and personalisation preferences stay in this browser. They are not sent to or retained on the NDee server. They remain until you or the browser delete them, with no automatic expiry. Exported PDFs and QR codes are under your control.

server.title: Community and professional features
server.text: Submitting an exercise sends its content to the server for moderation and publication. Helpful votes retain a pseudonymous identifier to prevent duplicates. Professional accounts store contact details and a hashed password. Local deletion below does not delete these server records. The host also receives technical request data such as IP addresses, without your questionnaire answers. Accounts and contributions are processed at your request to provide these services; vote identifiers prevent abuse. These server records currently have no automatic expiry.

cookies.title: Cookies and offline use
cookies.text: The browser remembers language, progress and data needed for offline use. Professional areas use a login cookie valid for 24 hours. NDee includes no advertising trackers. External sites apply their own rules.

rights.title: Deletion and rights
rights.text: The buttons below delete the indicated local data. For requests about accounts, contributions or access, correction and erasure rights, contact Kash Hauzeur below. Where applicable, you may also request restriction or portability, object to processing and complain to the Belgian Data Protection Authority.
